title: Submission details
purpose: Create or edit shipment and project information before sending a declaration to the laboratory. Samples are added on the submission page.
summary: The project and shipment details of a sample submission. You add the samples on the submission page afterwards.

tasks.title: Start a submission
steps: Choose the [[Project]] and enter the [[Chain of custody reference]] printed on your field paperwork.
Add the expected arrival, carrier and contact if you know them.
Select [[Create submission]]. It is saved as a Draft; nothing is sent yet.

tasks.title: Link the work to an accepted quote
steps: Choose the quote in [[Accepted quote]]. Pick the one that actually covers this work.

tasks.title: Correct the details
steps: Change the fields and select [[Save changes]]. Saving does not submit.

good_to_know: You can edit only while the submission is Draft or Returned for changes.
Writing a rush request or limits in Special instructions does not approve or configure them. The laboratory reads the note.
Expected arrival is your plan, not a receipt or a delivery commitment.
If the submission changed after you opened it, saving is refused. Reload and review it.

sections.title: Access
paragraphs: Sign in with an active client account. Every page, selection and action is limited to the client attached to your account, including work created by other users for the same client. Staff accounts cannot use these portal pages. Another client’s record is treated as missing.

sections.title: Eligibility
paragraphs: New records start as Draft. Existing details are editable only while Draft or Returned for changes. Submitted, Accepted and Cancelled records are read-only to clients. This declaration does not replace signed shipment custody paperwork.

items.label: Project
items.description: Required active project belonging to your client; your client must also be active. Contact the laboratory if the needed project is unavailable.

items.label: Accepted quote
items.description: Optional accepted quote belonging to your client. No project or test-coverage match is automatically enforced; select the quote actually covering this work. A quote is not required to submit.

items.label: Chain of custody reference
items.description: Required reference printed on your field chain of custody, up to 120 characters. Used to match paperwork and open laboratory intake after acceptance.

items.label: Expected arrival
items.description: Optional calendar date of intended arrival; not a physical receipt or a delivery commitment.

items.label: Carrier / tracking
items.description: Optional carrier/tracking details, up to 160 characters.

items.label: Number of coolers / packages
items.description: Optional non-negative whole-number package count. Describes the shipment, not sample containers; accepted up to 32,767.

items.label: Contact name
items.description: Optional person the laboratory should call about this shipment, up to 160 characters.

items.label: Contact phone
items.description: Optional phone details, up to 40 characters.

items.label: Special instructions
items.description: Optional notes such as requested rush approval, hazards, permit limits or reporting instructions. Text does not automatically approve a rush request or configure analytical limits.

items.label: Create submission
items.description: Assign a SUB number and save a Draft, then open detail so you can add samples. Repeating the same creation request returns the same record. Nothing is sent or received yet.

items.label: Save changes
items.description: Save the current Draft or Returned record and return to detail. Does not submit. If any submission content changed after opening, saving is refused; reload and review the current record.

items.label: Cancel / Submissions / submission number
items.description: Return to the list when creating, or to this record when editing, without saving.

items.label: Required fields and errors
items.description: Asterisks mark required fields. Errors appear beside fields or above the form; entered values stay available for correction after validation fails. A stale-record error requires reloading and reviewing the current record before retrying.

items.label: Maximize / Restore size
items.description: When this form opens in a dialog, change its size without saving. Small screens already use the full screen.

items.label: Close form / Cancel
items.description: Leave without saving. If the dialog detects edits, Keep editing returns to the form and Discard changes leaves without saving.

items.label: Try again
items.description: Retry if loading the dialog failed. During saving, wait for the request to finish; the submit button indicates work is running.
